Scoped Correspondence Formalism (SCF). Formal correspondence contracts between mathematical models, with an independently verified library.

```bash
pip install scoped-correspondence
```

Full release notes, including behaviour changes and migration notes, are in [RELEASE_NOTES.md](https://github.com/GenesisAeon/scoped-correspondence-formalism/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md). The project history and every review outcome are in [HISTORY.md](https://github.com/GenesisAeon/scoped-correspondence-formalism/blob/master/HISTORY.md).
